name: Gérard Larrousse
features: dark hair, broad handsome face, strong jaw, athletic build
bio: Rally champion turned Porsche long-distance man, second at Le Mans in 1969 and 1970 in works Porsches, the second time in the psychedelic 917 long-tail. Won the Nurburgring 1000 km and Sebring in the 908/03 and later the Targa Florio and Le Mans twice for Matra.
